title: types: `layout.zod.ts` imports `checkPageComponentViewData`, which objectstack `main` deleted (objectstack#23784), so objectstack's console pin no longer builds — drop the import
body:
Filing gate ④: a cross-repo child. This is the objectui half of objectstack-ai/objectstack#23908 (`domain:spec`, p1, `target:v18`), filed by the triage seat (objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015, `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U`), because that card's filer could not reach this repository. ⛔ Not a claim.

**Reader who acts:** the `domain:ui` seat, one PR. The precedent is objectui#5710, the same shape: dangling `@objectstack/spec/ui` imports in `packages/types/src/zod` breaking objectstack's Console Pin Gate.

## What breaks

- objectstack PR #23784 (`a35f7a6764`, merged 2026-10-16) deleted `checkPageComponentViewData` from `@objectstack/spec/ui`. Its title: "the component-props rule is the one judge of a page component's retired api data binding".
- objectstack's `pnpm objectui:build` builds this repo's console at objectstack's `.objectui-sha` against objectstack's own spec tree. It now fails with `[MISSING_EXPORT] "checkPageComponentViewData" is not exported by "packages/spec/dist/ui/index.mjs"`. objectstack's hourly full run is red on it (objectstack-ai/objectstack#23885, diagnosis `6214926932`).
- No later `@objectstack/spec` release will carry the export, so this repo's own next spec bump would fail on it too.

## Where (objectui `main`, read now)

- `packages/types/src/zod/layout.zod.ts:25`: the import.
- `packages/types/src/__tests__/imported-defaults-8317.test.ts:145` and `:710`, and `packages/types/src/__tests__/spec-object-refinements-7715.test.ts:316`–`:326`: tests that name it.

## Done when

- No file in this repo imports or names `checkPageComponentViewData`.
- The page-component check reads what the installed spec offers in its place. Read the installed `18.0.0-next.2` before deleting; the claimant measures what replaces it.
- A build of the console at this PR's head, against objectstack `main`'s spec (objectstack `scripts/build-console.sh` with `OBJECTSTACK_SPEC_DIST`), exits 0. The PR names the commit, so objectstack's pin move can carry it.

## Grade

p1 + `target:v18`, as objectstack#23908: a spec export removal, and objectstack's console build on `main` is red until both halves land.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectui, all states: `checkPageComponentViewData import layout.zod.ts removed spec console pin build` returned 11 hits. None is this import. The nearest are objectui#5710 (closed, the theme-schema precedent) and objectui#12468 (closed, the `jsx` kind).

Dedupe words: checkPageComponentViewData import; layout.zod.ts missing export; console pin gate MISSING_EXPORT.
